checkpoint_selection: Ultralytics best.pt selected using validation fitness only
counting_mae_definition: mean absolute error across image-class cells (N times 5); also report sum-count MAE
exact_count_accuracy_definition: fraction of images whose entire five-class count vector matches
test_gate: Only after configuration and selected checkpoint SHA-256 are frozen; validation mAP50 must be nonzero and cell counting MAE must beat always-zero. Otherwise leave test untouched.
test_policy: One final evaluation of the frozen checkpoint. No changes or second experiment based on test results.
size_claims: Red Bull sizes are not separate labels, so size accuracy cannot be measured.
